answer: Each new seat is grafted onto the vine beneath the seat that vouched for it, and the vine counts every graft each voucher has made. A voucher's Nth graft holds only once N seats from other root branches co-sign it, each locking 5 dune in the vault, forfeited if the graft co-votes with its voucher's other grafts. A newcomer needs one outside co-signer and 5 dune. An operator grafting 30 clones under one seat needs 465 outside co-signers locking 2,325 dune, each a stranger to bribe, and every fresh voucher it uses instead must first be grafted itself.
